description: Save or delete a named composition schema. Use it when retaining a UiSchema across sessions; use schema_read to list or load saved schemas. Returns the saved metadata or deletion result. save takes schemaRef, overwrites that name and increments its version; only the latest is loadable. Both actions write immediately. Full schema: oods://schemas/schema_store.input.json.

name.description: Saved schema name in slug format (letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores). Actions: save (required), delete (required).

schemaRef.description: Reference to an in-memory schema produced by design_compose. Actions: save (required).

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering and discovery. Actions: save.

name: schema_store
title: Save Or Delete Schemas
